cs-lewis.text: With my mother's death all settled happiness, all that was tranquil and reliable, disappeared from my life.
Suddenly, at the very moment when, so far, I mourned Helen least, I remembered her best.
Lazarus was raised from the dead to die again.

abraham-lincoln.text: Perfect relief is not possible, except with time.
You are sure to be happy again.
In this sad world of ours, sorrow comes to all.

bill-wilson.text: Simple, but not easy; a price had to be paid.

bill-wilson.text: We claim spiritual progress rather than spiritual perfection.
bill-wilson.source: Bill W. and the fellowship, How It Works, Alcoholics Anonymous (first edition), 1939

bill-wilson.text: Don't start out as an evangelist or reformer.
bill-wilson.source: Bill W. and the fellowship, Working With Others, Alcoholics Anonymous (first edition), 1939

gottmans.text: It was possible to predict marital outcome over a 6-year period using just the first 3 minutes of data
